SUBLEASE AGREEMENT

THIS SUBLEASE AGREEMENT (this "Sublease") is made as of September 1, 2026, between ORTHOGONAL LABS, INC., a Delaware corporation ("Sublandlord"), and PELLWORTH & KIRUNA DESIGN LLC, an Illinois limited liability company ("Subtenant").

RECITALS

A. Sublandlord, as tenant, and FULTON MARKET REALTY III LLC, an Illinois limited liability company ("Prime Landlord"), as landlord, are parties to that certain Office Lease dated June 15, 2022, as amended by a First Amendment to Office Lease dated November 1, 2024 (as amended, the "Prime Lease"), covering the entire ninth floor at 1130 West Fulton Market, Chicago, Illinois (the "Prime Premises").

B. Sublandlord wishes to sublet a portion of the Prime Premises to Subtenant, and Subtenant wishes to sublet that portion from Sublandlord, on the terms below.

C. Capitalized terms used but not defined in this Sublease have the meanings given in the Prime Lease.

AGREEMENT

1. Sublease of the Subleased Premises. Sublandlord subleases to Subtenant, and Subtenant subleases from Sublandlord, approximately 4,850 rentable square feet in the northeast quadrant of the ninth floor, as shown on Exhibit A (the "Subleased Premises").

2. Term. The term of this Sublease begins on October 1, 2026 (the "Sublease Commencement Date") and ends on May 31, 2029 (the "Sublease Expiration Date"), unless sooner terminated. The Sublease Expiration Date is one day before the expiration of the term of the Prime Lease. In no event shall the term of this Sublease extend beyond the term of the Prime Lease, and if the Prime Lease terminates for any reason before the Sublease Expiration Date, this Sublease terminates on the same date.

3. Base Rent. Subtenant shall pay Sublandlord base rent of $12,125.00 per month, payable in advance on the first day of each month without notice, demand, offset, or deduction. Base rent for any partial month is prorated on a per diem basis. Rent not paid within five (5) days after it is due bears interest at 8% per annum from the due date until paid.

4. Additional Rent. Subtenant shall pay, as additional rent, its proportionate share of any increase in operating expenses and real estate taxes charged to Sublandlord under the Prime Lease over the amounts charged for calendar year 2027, prorated on the basis that the rentable area of the Subleased Premises bears to the rentable area of the Prime Premises. Sublandlord shall deliver to Subtenant a copy of each statement it receives from Prime Landlord within ten (10) business days after receipt.

5. Security Deposit. On signing this Sublease, Subtenant shall deposit $24,250.00 with Sublandlord as security for Subtenant's performance. Sublandlord shall hold the deposit in a segregated account, shall not commingle it with its own funds, and shall return the balance, with any interest required by law, within thirty (30) days after the Sublease Expiration Date, less any amount properly applied to cure a default.

6. Use. Subtenant shall use the Subleased Premises solely for general office and design studio use, and for no other purpose. Subtenant shall not use the Subleased Premises in any manner that would violate the Prime Lease or cause Sublandlord to be in default under it.

7. Condition; As-Is. Subtenant accepts the Subleased Premises in their AS-IS, WHERE-IS condition as of the Sublease Commencement Date, with no representation or warranty by Sublandlord as to their condition or suitability, and with no obligation on Sublandlord to perform any improvement, alteration, or repair, except as expressly stated in Section 9.

8. Incorporation of the Prime Lease. Except as modified by this Sublease, the terms of the Prime Lease are incorporated into this Sublease and apply between Sublandlord and Subtenant as if Sublandlord were the landlord and Subtenant were the tenant under the Prime Lease. Subtenant assumes and agrees to perform all of the obligations of the tenant under the Prime Lease to the extent they relate to the Subleased Premises and arise during the term of this Sublease, other than the obligation to pay base rent and additional rent to Prime Landlord, which remains Sublandlord's. Sections 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 30 and 41 of the Prime Lease are excluded.

9. Sublandlord's Obligations. Sublandlord shall pay all rent due under the Prime Lease when due, shall perform its obligations under the Prime Lease, and shall not voluntarily terminate, surrender, or amend the Prime Lease in a way that increases Subtenant's obligations or reduces Subtenant's rights under this Sublease without Subtenant's prior written consent. Sublandlord shall use commercially reasonable efforts, at Subtenant's cost, to enforce Prime Landlord's obligations under the Prime Lease for the benefit of the Subleased Premises.

10. Alterations. Subtenant shall make no alteration to the Subleased Premises without the prior written consent of both Sublandlord and Prime Landlord, which consent Sublandlord shall not unreasonably withhold, condition, or delay.

11. Assignment and Subletting. Subtenant shall not assign this Sublease or further sublet any part of the Subleased Premises without the prior written consent of Sublandlord and Prime Landlord, which Sublandlord may withhold in its sole discretion.

12. Insurance. Subtenant shall carry commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and $4,000,000 in the aggregate, property insurance on its own personal property and improvements, and workers' compensation insurance as required by Illinois law. Subtenant shall name Sublandlord and Prime Landlord as additional insureds and shall deliver certificates of insurance before the Sublease Commencement Date and on each renewal.

13. Indemnification. Subtenant shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Sublandlord and Prime Landlord from and against all claims, damages, liabilities, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising out of Subtenant's use or occupancy of the Subleased Premises or Subtenant's breach of this Sublease, except to the extent caused by Sublandlord's negligence or willful misconduct. Sublandlord shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Subtenant from and against all claims arising out of Sublandlord's breach of the Prime Lease not caused by Subtenant.

14. Default. Each of the following is an event of default by Subtenant: (a) failure to pay base rent or additional rent within five (5) days after written notice that it is past due; (b) failure to perform any other obligation under this Sublease within twenty (20) days after written notice, or, if the failure cannot reasonably be cured in twenty days, failure to begin the cure within that period and pursue it diligently; and (c) an assignment for the benefit of creditors or the filing of a bankruptcy petition by Subtenant that is not dismissed within sixty (60) days.

15. Remedies. On an event of default, Sublandlord may exercise every remedy available to a landlord under Illinois law and every remedy Prime Landlord has against Sublandlord under the Prime Lease, including termination of this Sublease and recovery of possession, and including recovery of unpaid rent, the costs of reletting, and reasonable attorneys' fees. Sublandlord shall use reasonable efforts to relet the Subleased Premises and to mitigate its damages as required by Illinois law.

16. Prime Landlord's Consent. This Sublease is of no force or effect until Prime Landlord consents to it in writing under Section 14 of the Prime Lease. If Prime Landlord has not consented within forty-five (45) days after the date of this Sublease, either party may terminate this Sublease by written notice to the other, and Sublandlord shall return the security deposit.

17. Surrender. On the Sublease Expiration Date or earlier termination, Subtenant shall surrender the Subleased Premises in the condition required by the Prime Lease, ordinary wear and tear excepted, and shall remove its personal property and any alteration Sublandlord or Prime Landlord required it to remove at the time consent was given.

18. Notices. All notices under this Sublease shall be in writing and delivered by hand, by nationally recognized overnight courier, or by certified mail, return receipt requested, to the addresses beneath the parties' signatures, and are effective on receipt or refusal of receipt.

19. Governing Law. This Sublease is governed by the laws of the State of Illinois, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. Each party consents to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts sitting in Cook County, Illinois.

20. Miscellaneous. This Sublease, together with the Prime Lease as incorporated, is the entire agreement of the parties as to the Subleased Premises. It may be amended only by a writing signed by both parties, and, where the Prime Lease so requires, consented to by Prime Landlord. It binds and benefits the parties and their permitted successors and assigns. It may be executed in counterparts, including by electronic signature.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Sublease as of the date first written above.
